name: Amulet of Secret Identity
body:
Price 1,500 gp; Aura faint illusion; CL 1st; Slot neck; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

While you wear this item, you count as having a masked persona, which is similar to the dual identity vigilante class feature. It takes 24 hours to gain this identity, and your masked persona is always the same. Switching between your normal identity and masked persona requires 1 minute when using an amulet of secret identity, and the amulet provides a +10 insight bonus to Disguise checks to appear in your current identity.

If you have the dual identity class feature, the amulet allows you to function as if you have the quick change social talent. If you also have the quick change social talent, you instead function as if you have the immediate change social talent. You gain no further benefit if you already have the immediate change social talent.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells oath of anonymity; Cost 750 gp
